frequency_question: How often do motivated legislative principals successfully push a resolution of disapproval through both chambers to block an executive international agreement within the statutory review window?
membership_rule: Includes instances of statutory review periods for 123 agreements or major arms sales where the opposing party holds or builds sufficient legislative initiative to force votes on joint resolutions of disapproval. Excludes cases where principals are passive or merely voice rhetorical opposition without advancing legislative vehicles.
